# Luba AI
> Luba AI is a web-based AI chat assistant created by Kobi under the company Kobiverse.
> Live application: https://luba-ai.vercel.app
> TikTok: @luba_ai
> Official email: lubaai.official@gmail.com

## Company
- **Kobiverse** is Kobi's company. It is the company behind Luba AI.
- **Luba AI** is the AI chat product of Kobiverse, built and maintained by Kobi (solo developer / owner).
- Owner account in the app is typically username **kobi**.
- Luba AI and Kobiverse are independent. They are not affiliated with Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, Roblox, or any other large AI/tech company.

## Overview
Luba AI is an interactive AI chat assistant web app. Users can create accounts (login / sign up), chat with Luba, upload photos and files, save chats, use modes (including HTML mode that builds runnable single-file apps and games in chat), use slash commands, optional live web search, leaderboard, themes, and more. Backend infrastructure uses Cloudflare Workers and KV storage. The live site is hosted at https://luba-ai.vercel.app.

## Key features
- Account system: username login/sign up, verified badge, admin role, owner tools
- Chat with personality; message limits for free users; higher limits for verified/admin/owner
- HTML / code mode: generates complete single-file HTML apps that can be opened, copied, or downloaded from chat
- Media: photos, videos, files; saved chats (up to 100 per account)
- Slash commands (e.g. search, copy, exactly, and others)
- Optional web search integration for real-time information
- Settings, light/dark theme, leaderboard
- In-app origin page: "Luba's story" (Settings)

## Origin (Luba's story)
Luba started as a personal "dump project" after Kobi's main Roblox account was permanently banned (reason listed as "Other"), including device restrictions. To cope, Kobi began building a small AI chat project that grew into a full product with accounts, media, modes, and HTML building. The story is available inside the app under Settings → Luba's story.
